notes: Conjunction-heavy phrasing: five 'and's, a trailing clause ('turned up at the last
minute'), and filler ('So today we had') that must not become names.
First-name-only collisions 'Alex' and 'Dan' are ambiguous — suggest, never auto-pick.
'Laura E' is qualified, so it resolves cleanly even though 'Laura K' exists.
'ten point four two kilometres' -> 10.42 (two spoken decimal digits, full unit word).
